CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_member()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM private.beta_members m
    WHERE m.owner_id=(SELECT auth.uid())
      AND m.enabled
      AND m.admitted_at IS NOT NULL
  );
$function$
